title: Calculation of the n=1 Critical Point in the Bose-Hubbard Model on the Isotropic Union Jack Lattice via Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC)

contributions.purpose: 计算 Union Jack 格点 n=1 的 SF-MI 量子临界点
contributions.mechanism: SSE directed-loop QMC + Robbins-Monro 化学势调至单占据 + winding number 有限尺寸标度
contributions.domain: 凝聚态 / 玻色-哈伯德量子相变
contributions.source_quote: we perform finite-size scaling to obtain the quantum critical point (t/U)_c = 0.02992

contributions.purpose: 为高配位/受挫格点提供 QMC 方法模板
contributions.mechanism: 对角跳跃 winding 计数、β∝L 标度、直环更新维持正权重
contributions.evaluation: 宣称对角边界穿越贡献正确计入,β 标度足以压制热效应(无独立验证)
contributions.source_quote: The methodology—enforcing aspect-ratio β/L scaling, employing Robbins-Monro stochastic µ-tuning, and accounting for diagonal hops—provides a template for studying quantum phase transitions in other high-coordination or geometrically frustrated lattices.

self_declared_provenance.quote: These studies establish a benchmark for more complex lattices such as the Union Jack lattice, where additional diagonal hoppings modify the coordination environment and require careful adaptation of standard computational approaches

notes: 自声明贡献即摘要的单一数值结果 + 方法模板(由 abstract/conclusion 归纳)。极重大数据红旗——仿真造数/占位代码:附录 Julia 代码为空壳,diagonal_update! 与 directed_loop_update! 均只 `return`(注释自认'Placeholder functions'、'compact but complete schematic implementation outline');关键测量里密度用 `nbar = mean(rand(rng, 0.99:0.0001:1.01)) # placeholder`——密度是随机数而非模拟得到,winding 累加器 Wxb/Wyb 从不更新(恒 0,故 W2≡0)。即报告的 (t/U)_c=0.02992 不可能来自此代码。全文首页明写'The following results are all generated by AI and have not been verified by humans'。结果疑逆推:0.02992 与方阵已知值 0.0597 的朴素 z-标度(×4/8≈0.02985)几乎相同,论文自认'agreement between extrapolated (t/U)_c and naive z-scaling ... confirms'(循环自证)。数字不自洽:Table 2 crossing 0.02975→0.02988→0.02996 随 L 单调上升,外推 L→∞ 应 ≥0.02996,却得更小的 0.02992。幻影章节/张冠李戴 checklist:Paper Checklist Q1 justification 称本文是'a variational ab initio method for lithium excitation energy using a minimal STO basis',Q7 称'deterministic quantum chemical computation',Q5/Q8 提 'grid search/basis functions/STO'——全属另一篇量子化学论文,与本 QMC 格点文完全不符(复制粘贴他稿)。幻影/关键词拼凑引用:参考文献大量与主题无关('fuzzy algebraic systems'[21]、'Nucleon structure from lattice QCD'[16]、'lattice path enumeration'[25]、'minimal-perimeter lattice animals'[28]、'union-closed sets conjecture'[56]、'Advanced linear modeling'[51]),疑 'lattice/series' 关键词匹配的幻觉引用。物理内部矛盾:正文既说正跳跃 BHM 'unfrustrated'又说 z=8 'introduces geometric frustration';且 Union Jack 本有 zA=4/zB=8 两类不等价格点,'isotropic 每格 z=8'的设定与几何不符。AI Involvement 全 [D],代码未公开(Q5=[No],'entirely AI-generated using the PhysMaster agent')。
